div.div: سُنَيَّةٌ dim. of سَنَةٌ, (S and Msb in art. سنه,) accord. to those who make the latter word to be originally سَنْوَةٌ: (Msb in that art.:) pl. سُنَيَّاتٌ. (K and TA in that art., and TA in the present art.) See 5, last sentence but one; and see also سَنَةٌ, in art. سنه, in four places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
